items.title: Mickey Roker interviewed by Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: Jimmy Heath is the guy that introduced me to Milt Jackson years ago.

ctx.x: Who did you get some of your first gigs with?

Well I played rhythm & blues in Philly with a band, a guy named King James. I did that for a year in a group with Jimmy Devine called the High Five. We had a band together for about a year, and then I decided that playing that way is so limited you know. So I devoted my life to playing jazz because it’s more free, it’s open you know, and you can express more rhythm. So then I started playing with people like Sam Reed, all these Philadelphia musicians, and Jimmy Heath and Jimmy Oliver. Jimmy Heath is the guy that…
play with Gigi Gryce. So I played with Gigi Gryce for a couple of years, played with Ray Bryant for a couple of years, and then that’s when I joined Joe Williams’ band with the Junior Mance Trio.
